notes.subject: וחללו
notes.rationale: Root חלל 'profane/make common': 'eat them as common things' (KJV) vs 'enjoy the fruit' (ASV/BSB) vs Wycliffe's 'shall not gather grapes'.

notes.subject: נטעו נטעים
notes.rationale: Infinitive-absolute style repetition of the plant root, 'planting they shall plant', intensified in Hebrew, flattened in Tok Pisin.

translation: Bihain yu bai wokim gaden wainim long ol maunten bilong Shomeron; ol man i wokim gaden bai wokim gaden, na bai ol i usim frut olsem olgeta man i ken kaikai.
